projects.title: Small-Image Classification Capstone
bullets: Applied simple input transformations to public handwritten-symbol images as part of a supervised undergraduate capstone project.
Trained a compact image classifier using Python, PyTorch and NumPy for small-image classification under input changes.

projects.title: Environmental Time-Series Forecasting Course Project
bullets: Aligned public rainfall measurement time series and identified missing observations as part of a supervised undergraduate course project.
Implemented a seasonal baseline for forecasting from public rainfall measurement series using Python, pandas and scikit-learn.

research.title: Small-Image Classification Research Assistance
bullets: Loaded public texture image datasets and trained a compact image classifier using Python, PyTorch and NumPy.
Summarized classification errors in small-image classification under input changes as a supervised student research assistant.
